I am an old woman now, 78 years, and this small plot near the house I plant with mixed things — I cannot afford the bag fertilizer from the shop, it costs too much and here in Mtwara few of us use it. I will use the kitchen ash and any goat droppings I can gather, and I plant the seeds I saved from last season like my mother taught me. My grandchildren help me with the weeding and harvesting since my back is not strong, but the plot is small so we manage without paying anyone.
